issues.description: Typographical error in Czech: 'uvedťe' in the data flow bullet is misspelled.
issues.required_fix: Correct 'uvedťe' to 'uveďte' in the line: 'Tok dat: sběr → ukládání → přístup → retention → mazání (uvedťe lokace dat: VUT cloud / externí poskytovatel).' and make language consistent (see next issue).

issues.description: Inconsistent language use: the word 'retention' appears in an otherwise Czech text (should use Czech equivalent).
issues.required_fix: Replace 'retention' with a Czech term such as 'uchovávání' or 'retence' so the bullet reads e.g. 'Tok dat: sběr → ukládání → přístup → uchovávání → mazání'.

issues.description: Ambiguous/duplicate acronym 'DPA/DPA' in the list of contractual controls (section 3).
issues.required_fix: Clarify the intended term. If meaning is 'Data Processing Agreement', use 'DPA (smlouva o zpracování osobních údajů)' or if intending to reference both DPA and DPIA, write 'DPA / DPIA' with short parenthetical explanations.

issues.description: Several recommended technical and contractual measures in section 3 (e.g. 'SSO + role‑based access', 'auditní logy', 'šifrování v klidu i v přenosu', 'DPA body') are presented as recommendations but are not consistently marked as 'general background knowledge' and lack inline linkage to the handbook sections that justify them.
issues.required_fix: Either mark these items explicitly as 'general background knowledge' or add cross-references to the relevant earlier handbook sections (e.g. 2.2 / 8.2 / 8.3) to ground the recommendations.

issues.description: The section already contains some items marked '(general background knowledge)', but not all normative-sounding recommendations are flagged consistently.
issues.required_fix: Consistently annotate general best-practice advice with '(general background knowledge)' where the template is giving non‑legal, advisory recommendations rather than institution-specific mandatory requirements.

issues.description: The template suggests saving completed DPIAs to ai.vut.cz but provides no explicit instruction on folder structure, access permissions or retention of those documents.
issues.required_fix: Add a short note suggesting where to store completed DPIAs (e.g. a shared repository path or team) and to set appropriate access controls and retention consistent with faculty policy, or reference the 'Kontakty a podpora VUT' appendix for repository rules.

issues.description: The checklist and workflow are practical but would benefit from a short, fully filled example DPIA or a link to a sample (the 'Příloha' gives a brief example, but a completed example would help).
issues.required_fix: Recommend adding a short completed example DPIA (one‑page filled sample) or a link to a repository example in the Příloha to illustrate expected level of detail.

suggested_edits.edit_instruction: Fix typos and language consistency: change 'uvedťe' → 'uveďte' and 'retention' → 'uchovávání' (or 'retence').

Clarify contractual item: replace 'Smluvní zajištění: DPA/DPA body s poskytovatelem (uchovávání, mazání, možnost auditu).' with 'Smluvní zajištění: DPA (smlouva o zpracování osobních údajů) — klíčové body: podmínky uchovávání, mazání, právo na audit a popis rolí správce/zpracovatele.'

Either mark each technical/organizational control as '(general background knowledge)' or add inline cross-references to handbook sections that support them (e.g. reference 2.2, 8.2, 8.3 for IAM, encryption, DPA).

Add a short instruction where to save completed DPIA files (suggested repository path and who has access) or point to the repository described in 9.9; and suggest including one completed example DPIA in the Příloha or repository.
Consider neutral wording for roles (e.g. 'učitelé/asistenti' or 'učitel/ka, asistent/ka') for consistency with other sections, or keep current form if consistent with style guide.
